issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-10950](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10950)
### Description

Commit 4c6dbf8d8dbcf1697660b48dfa810ae31146c57c introduces `TEST_F(GeoTransactionsPromotionRF1Test, TestTwoTabletPromotionFailure)`.  According to [internal detective](https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/D28890/), this test failed on alma8-clang16-release-aarch64.  The [internal logs](https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/cloud_bucket/%2Fjob%2Fyugabyte-db-phabricator%252F220619%252Fartifact%252Fbuild%252Frelease-clang16-full-lto-ninja%252Fyb-test-logs%252Ftests-pgwrapper__geo_transactions_promotion-test%252FGeoTransactionsPromotionRF1Test_TestTwoTabletPromotionFailure.log%3Fclass=GeoTransactionsPromotionRF1Test&name=TestTwoTabletPromotionFailure) indicate

```
E1205 19:41:58.911597 33061 run-with-timeout.cc:56] Timeout reached, trying to stop the child process with SIGSEGV
```

Today, the test is still failing from time to time across different build types with the same issue.  For example, [internal build log on commit 7036256e](https://jenkins.dev.yugabyte.com/job/github-yugabyte-db-alma8-master-clang17-release/421/artifact/build/release-clang17-full-lto-ninja/yb-test-logs/tests-pgwrapper__geo_transactions_promotion-test/GeoTransactionsPromotionRF1Test_TestTwoTabletPromotionFailure.log) shows

```
[ts-2] W0416 20:22:40.282581 115587 thread.cc:695] Waited for 624.000s trying to join with rpc_tp_TabletServer_5 (tid 116187)
E0416 20:22:40.545439 115588 run-with-timeout.cc:58] Timeout reached, trying to stop the child process with SIGSEGV
```

This kind of test failure is particularly painful because it is a waste of 10 minutes for a test that normally completes under 30 seconds.

[internal detective analyze trends](https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?analyze_trends=true&branch=master&class=GeoTransactionsPromotionRF1Test&name=TestTwoTabletPromotionFailure)
